subject.title: codex和chatgpt合并后，无法添加新账号了

question: Should managed Codex Add Account continue to require a separately installed Codex CLI, or should CodexBar add an in-app installation/direct-auth recovery path?
rationale: Current behavior and docs intentionally depend on the upstream CLI; removing that prerequisite or installing tooling changes provider-auth and setup policy, while merely improving diagnostics is a narrower UX change.

options.title: Add Doctor and install recovery
options.body: Keep CLI-based managed login but add an in-app diagnostic, approved installation or locate action, and retry path.

options.title: Keep CLI prerequisite
options.body: Retain the current dependency and improve the account pane’s prerequisite text and support instructions only.

options.title: Design direct authentication
options.body: Replace the CLI login dependency with a CodexBar-owned authentication flow after a separate auth/privacy design review.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor and install recovery
recommendation.body: Keep CLI-based managed login but add an in-app diagnostic, approved installation or locate action, and retry path.

likelyOwner.reason: The managed-account implementation, missing-binary handling, and recent settings surface are primarily tied to his repository history.
